events.title: Highway 90 Dispensary RnB Chill’s Summer Finale Festival!
events.html:
Highway 90 Presents: RnB & Chill’s Summer Finale Festival!

Exclusive Dispensary Sponsorship…
Renowned R&B Headliners… Bringing all the vibes!

R&B is more than just another genre; it’s the groove. The kind of groove you usually reserve for your favorite dispensary products at Highway 90.

This year, we’re combining the two into a festive celebration!

On Saturday, October 10th, 2026, from 12 PM–7 PM, join us at the Gloucester County Fairgrounds for the RnB & Chill Summer Finale Festival, featuring headliner artist J. Holiday.

Also featuring Hip-Hop & R&B artists Sammie and Luke Nasty!

Another thing… Highway 90 is doing free ticket giveaways! Spend over $60 on your order, OR Follow, Like, Share our content on Instagram to be entered for a chance to win a FREE TICKET for the RnB & Chill Summer Finale Festival

While we’re keeping our own best deals under wraps for now 👀, we can promise an unforgettable festival packed with store-wide savings, awesome giveaways, live entertainment, and a stacked schedule of brand pop-ups and local flavor.

💥 Here’s What to Expect:

🍃 Exclusive & Vendor Pop-Ups
Meet the Highway 90 team face-to-face, learn more about our products, and score exclusive swag with your favorite products.

🍃 Brand Partnership

We are partnered with Clade9 in bringing the best experience to festival attendees. Find our respective tents for merch and exclusive high -value Clade9/Highway 90 coupons

🎶 Live Music All Weekend
Feel the vibe with local musicians bringing the energy—from chill afternoon sets to upbeat evening jams.

🌭 Local Eats & Food Trucks
Come hungry! We’re featuring some of the best local food trucks serving up hot dogs, cheesesteaks, and other munchie must-haves.

🛍️ Goodie Bags & Giveaways
Early birds and lucky winners will get hooked up with limited edition swag, branded goodies, and maybe even a few surprises.

🔥 Massive Store-Wide Discounts
We can’t reveal the full list just yet, but trust us—you’ll want to stock up.

✨ Exclusive Products & Surprise Drops
Be on the lookout for one-time drops and limited items only available during our 4/20 celebration.

✅ Save the Date. Spread the Word. Bring Your Friends.

Whether you’re looking to dance, just vibing out, or stopping by to enjoy the scene—RnB & Chill is the place to be this 10/10 weekend. Follow us on social and subscribe to our emails so you’re first to know when our official deals drop!

– Highway 90 Dispensary 
Best Dispensary in NJ
